shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,90p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- uikit docs table refs ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path '*docs*Table*' -o -path '*docs*Pagination*' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- table typings ---'; rg -n \"declare const Table|withTableSorting|withTableSelection|SortingDirection|onUpdateSort|selectedIds|onUpdateSelectedIds|sort\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/legacy/table/table.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/legacy/table -g '*.d.ts' | head -180; printf '%s\\n' '--- pagination typings ---'; rg -n \"declare const Pagination|onUpdatePage|pageSize|page\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/legacy/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- Table.d.ts ---'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- sorting hoc ---'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- selection hoc ---'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- Pagination ---'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- exports ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/index.d.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- sorting impl ---'; rg -n \"meta|sort\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -60; printf '%s\\n' '--- selection impl ---'; rg -n \"selectionColumnId|isRowSelectionDisabled|getRowId\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -60; printf '%s\\n' '--- app ---'; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx vite.config.ts tsconfig.json"
